mergedParams.userDescription: High-speed rotational spin blur twist warp transition effects between videos

output.title: High-Speed Spin Blur Twist Warp Video Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create a high-speed rotational spin blur warp transition preset that implements a 360-degree spiral twist effect between two video clips. The transition should use a 1-second overlap period where the outgoing video rotates clockwise while scaling down and blurring out, while the incoming video simultaneously rotates counter-clockwise from a scaled-down blurred state to full clarity. Use transform rotate animations with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) easing for an elastic spin effect. The blur should progressively increase to 20px on the outgoing video and decrease from 20px to 0 on the incoming video. Add a subtle shake effect during the peak rotation moment (0.4-0.6 seconds into the transition) for extra dynamism. Position both videos absolutely with 'inset-0' and use z-index layering with the incoming video on top.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1s overlap. First VideoAtom with duration={video1.duration}, second VideoAtom with startTime={video1.duration - 1} and duration={video2.duration}. Generic effects in provider mode: outgoing video gets opacity 1→0, rotate 0→360deg, scale 1→0.3, blur 0→20px all from startTime={video1.duration - 1} for 1s. Incoming video gets opacity 0→1, rotate -360→0deg, scale 0.3→1, blur 20→0px same timing. Shake effect using translateX/Y with random values ±10px applied to container during 0.4-0.6s of transition. Use 'absolute inset-0 object-cover' for both videos, z-10 for incoming.

prompts.prompt: Design a warped tunnel vortex transition that creates an illusion of the outgoing video being sucked into a spinning vortex while the incoming video emerges from the center. Implement a 1.5-second overlap where the outgoing video applies a combination of scale-down (1 to 0.1), rotation (0 to 720 degrees), and increasing blur (0 to 30px) with exponential easing. The incoming video should start from the center point (scale 0.1) with maximum blur and reverse-rotate (-720 to 0 degrees) while scaling up. Add a swirl distortion effect using multiple rotated duplicates of the videos at different opacities (0.3, 0.2, 0.1) with slight timing offsets (0.1s, 0.2s, 0.3s) to create motion blur trails. The transition should feel like traveling through a time-warp tunnel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with calculated duration, main videos plus 3 duplicate VideoAtoms per source for motion trails. Main outgoing: scale 1→0.1, rotate 0→720deg, blur 0→30px over 1.5s with ease-in-expo. Main incoming: scale 0.1→1, rotate -720→0deg, blur 30→0px with ease-out-expo. Trail duplicates use same source, lower opacity (0.3/0.2/0.1), staggered startTime offsets (+0.1s/+0.2s/+0.3s), slightly different rotation speeds (650deg/700deg/750deg). All videos use 'absolute inset-0 object-cover', trails behind mains via z-index. Transform-origin set to 'center' for perfect spiral.

prompts.prompt: Build a rapid-fire stroboscopic spin transition that alternates between showing fragments of outgoing and incoming videos during a 0.8-second overlap, creating a disorienting twist effect. Slice the transition into 8 rapid intervals (0.1s each) where visibility alternates between videos using step animations for opacity. During each strobe, apply incremental rotation (45-degree steps) so the full transition completes a 360-degree spin. Add a radial blur effect that pulses in sync with the strobes (0 to 15px blur on each flash). The incoming video should also scale from 1.5x to 1x during the transition while the outgoing scales from 1x to 0.5x. Include a slight RGB color channel split effect using red/blue filters with translateX offsets for a glitchy aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container, 0.8s overlap calculated into duration. Outgoing VideoAtom with step opacity animation (1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0) over 0.8s, rotate 0→360deg linear, scale 1→0.5. Incoming VideoAtom opacity (0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1), rotate 0→360deg, scale 1.5→1. Radial blur using filter animations pulsing 0→15px→0 every 0.1s. RGB split via 3 duplicate atoms per video: red filter translate(-2px,0), blue filter translate(2px,0), original in center. Use animation-timing-function: steps(8) for strobes. Position absolute, incoming z-20, outgoing z-10.

prompts.prompt: Create a smooth helical DNA-twist transition where videos spiral around each other like a double helix during a 2-second overlap. The outgoing video splits into two copies that rotate in opposite directions (clockwise and counter-clockwise) while moving along sine-wave paths horizontally. The incoming video does the same but with inverted phase. Use transform3d for true 3D rotation with rotateY animations (0 to 180deg for one copy, 0 to -180deg for the other). Apply perspective (1000px) to the container for depth. Each copy should oscillate vertically using translateY with sin-based keyframes while fading opacity from 1 to 0 (outgoing) or 0 to 1 (incoming). Add motion blur using multiple semi-transparent duplicates with slight time offsets.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with perspective:1000px style, 2s overlap in duration calc. Four main VideoAtoms (2 per source). Outgoing pair: copy1 with rotateY 0→180deg + translateX sin-wave + translateY oscillation, copy2 with rotateY 0→-180deg + inverted sin-wave. Incoming pair with opposite phase start. Opacity transitions 1→0 outgoing, 0→1 incoming. Add 2-3 motion trail duplicates per main atom at opacity 0.2-0.3 with 0.05s time offsets. Use transform-style:preserve-3d on container, 'absolute inset-0' positioning, alternating z-indices for helix weaving effect.

prompts.prompt: Design an aggressive whirlpool drain transition where the outgoing video appears to be sucked down a drain with increasing rotational speed and distortion. Implement a 1.2-second overlap using accelerating rotation (ease-in-cubic from 0 to 1080 degrees) combined with a spiral path animation. The video should follow a logarithmic spiral inward using both translateX/Y and scale animations. Start with scale 1 and end at scale 0, while the center point shifts using calculated spiral coordinates. The incoming video emerges from the same vortex point but in reverse, starting from scale 0 at the spiral center and expanding outward with decelerating rotation (1080 to 0 degrees with ease-out-cubic). Add increasing box-shadow blur for depth and a subtle sepia filter on the outgoing video.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.2s overlap duration calculation. Outgoing VideoAtom: rotate 0→1080deg ease-in-cubic, scale 1→0, spiral path via translateX/Y keyframes following logarithmic curve (calculated as x=r*cos(θ)*e^(-θ/4), y=r*sin(θ)*e^(-θ/4)). Incoming: rotate 1080→0deg ease-out-cubic, scale 0→1, reverse spiral path. Box-shadow animation 0→30px blur on outgoing, 30px→0 on incoming. Sepia filter 0→0.5 on outgoing. Transform-origin at 50% 50%, absolute positioning, incoming z-30 for proper layering.

prompts.prompt: Build a quantum spin-state transition that simulates quantum superposition with multiple probability states of both videos existing simultaneously before collapsing into the final state. Create 5 semi-transparent copies of each video during a 1-second overlap, each rotating at different speeds (180, 360, 540, 720, 900 degrees) with varying opacity levels (0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2) to represent probability distributions. All copies should oscillate in and out using scale pulses (0.9 to 1.1) at different frequencies. At the 0.7-second mark, trigger a 'collapse' where all outgoing copies rapidly converge to center and disappear while incoming copies suddenly snap to full opacity. Add chromatic aberration using RGB channel splits that intensify during the collapse moment.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container, 1s overlap. 5 VideoAtoms per source (10 total). Outgoing set: different rotations (180/360/540/720/900deg) over 0.7s, opacities (0.2/0.3/0.4/0.3/0.2)→0, scale oscillations via keyframes. Incoming set: same rotation pattern, opacities 0→(0.2/0.3/0.4/0.3/0.2)→1 with snap at 0.7s. Collapse animation: all atoms converge using translateX/Y→0 with ease-in-expo from 0.7-1s. RGB split via filter or duplicate atoms with red/blue translateX ±3px during collapse. Absolute positioning with staggered z-indices.

prompts.prompt: Create a tornado twist-off transition where the outgoing video is torn away in a spiraling tornado motion while the incoming video assembles from scattered pieces. Fragment each video into 4 quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) using clip-path or mask. During a 1.3-second overlap, each outgoing quadrant rotates at different speeds (270, 360, 450, 540 degrees) while following individual spiral trajectories outward. The incoming quadrants start scattered and rotating rapidly (540, 450, 360, 270 degrees) then spiral inward to reassemble. Add turbulence using random translate wobbles and a dust particle effect with small semi-transparent shapes that swirl around the tornado path.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.3s overlap. 8 VideoAtoms (4 per source) with clip-path for quadrants: polygon(0 0, 50% 0, 50% 50%, 0 50%) etc. Outgoing quads: individual rotate animations (270/360/450/540deg), spiral out via translateX/Y keyframes, opacity 1→0. Incoming quads: start with translate offsets, rotate (540/450/360/270deg)→0, spiral in to position, opacity 0→1. Add ShapeAtoms for dust (10-20 small circles) with complex path animations following tornado curve, opacity 0.1-0.3. Random translate wobble ±5px via keyframes on all quads.

prompts.prompt: Design a gyroscopic gimbal transition that simulates a 3-axis gimbal system with nested rotations. The outgoing video rotates on X-axis (pitch), Y-axis (yaw), and Z-axis (roll) simultaneously, creating a complex tumbling motion during a 1.5-second overlap. Use rotateX (0 to 360deg), rotateY (0 to 270deg), and rotateZ (0 to 450deg) with different timing functions (ease-in, linear, ease-out respectively). The incoming video starts with inverse rotations and unwinds to normal orientation. Add a metallic sheen effect using gradient overlays that move across the videos during rotation to simulate reflective surfaces. Include subtle lens distortion at the edges using a radial gradient mask that darkens the corners during peak rotation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with transform-style:preserve-3d, perspective:1200px, 1.5s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom: rotateX 0→360deg ease-in, rotateY 0→270deg linear, rotateZ 0→450deg ease-out, all simultaneous over 1.5s. Incoming: rotateX -360→0deg ease-out, rotateY -270→0deg linear, rotateZ -450→0deg ease-in. Add gradient overlay divs with linear-gradient metallic sheen, translate across video surface. Radial gradient mask using CSS mask-image for vignette effect, opacity 0→0.5→0 during rotation. Absolute positioning, backface-visibility:hidden for clean 3D.

prompts.prompt: Build a time-warp corkscrew transition where videos twist through time-space like a corkscrew pasta shape. Create a 1.8-second overlap where the outgoing video stretches vertically (scaleY 1 to 3) while rotating (0 to 540 degrees) and compressing horizontally (scaleX 1 to 0.3), creating a twisted ribbon effect. Simultaneously apply a wave distortion using multiple sliced segments (10 horizontal slices) with staggered rotation timings (0.1s delays between slices). The incoming video reverses this process, starting as a twisted ribbon and untwisting to normal. Add scan lines using repeating linear gradients and a CRT monitor flicker effect with rapid opacity fluctuations (0.95-1.0) to enhance the time-travel aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout, 1.8s overlap. For distortion effect, use 10 VideoAtoms per source with clip-path horizontal slices. Outgoing set: scaleY 1→3, scaleX 1→0.3, rotate 0→540deg, each slice delayed by index*0.1s. Incoming: scaleY 3→1, scaleX 0.3→1, rotate 540→0deg, same stagger pattern. Scan lines via ::before pseudo-element with repeating-linear-gradient(transparent 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 2px). Flicker via opacity keyframes 0.95→1→0.95 with 0.05s duration on infinite loop during transition. Transform-origin: center, absolute positioning.

prompts.prompt: Create a hyperdrive starfield warp transition where videos stretch and twist into light-speed streaks before snapping back. During a 0.6-second ultra-fast overlap, apply extreme horizontal scaling (scaleX 1 to 50) to create stretched light streaks while rotating rapidly (0 to 1440 degrees in 0.3s, then back to 0 in next 0.3s). Use motion blur by creating 20 duplicate frames of each video with minimal opacity (0.05 each) and slight time offsets (0.01s apart) to create persistence of vision trails. Add a bright flash at the midpoint using a white overlay div that peaks at the 0.3s mark. The incoming video should emerge from the light streaks with reverse scaling (50 to 1) while the outgoing dissolves into the streaks. Include subtle chromatic aberration increasing toward the edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout, 0.6s overlap. Main atoms: outgoing scaleX 1→50 (0-0.3s) then fade, rotate 0→1440→0deg. Incoming: scaleX 50→1 (0.3-0.6s), rotate 0→1440→0deg. 20 duplicate VideoAtoms per source at opacity:0.05, startTime staggered by index*0.01s for motion blur. White flash div: opacity 0→1→0 with peak at 0.3s, z-index:100. RGB channel split for chromatic aberration using filters or colored duplicates with translateX based on distance from center. Use will-change:transform for GPU acceleration.
